race.comment: Open race but fancy BEAUTIFUL BEVY (14) can measure up into her four year old season. Three runs this time in read well - a dominant maiden winner fresh, second to a possible superstar second up (beaten 6L) then good on speed last time when third. Stays down in the weights and will be hard to run down. BEHAVIOUR (5) sat on a slow pace and tested the unbeaten Tennessee Bound to the line last time at Caulfield. He's shown tactical speed his past two and been much better, he'll take beating again. HIGH ON THE HILL (6) is off a short spell. He wasn't far away in a handy 3yo race at Flemington last time out and had been racing well prior. Tricky draw but look for him late. NORDIC STRIKE (12) turns around quickly off a narrow second and will be hard to run down while MAINMANKASH (7) could measure up off a dominant BM62 victory.
